fields.acceptance: A web package test parses the embedded stylesheet and asserts the colour tokens of both themes equal the owner's basics (soil #0D0C09 ... rose #9A4F37) and that no gradient appears in it.
fields.statement: One embedded stylesheet carries the Claude Design system as CSS custom properties: the dark soil theme by default and the light paper theme under prefers-color-scheme, the gold, teal and rose accents, the Petrona, Instrument Sans and JetBrains Mono type scale, 12-16px radii and 1px rules, with no gradients.

fields.acceptance: A web package test GETs each font from the handler with a font content type, asserts each licence file is embedded, and asserts the rendered layout references no http(s) URL outside the page's own origin.
fields.statement: Petrona, Instrument Sans and JetBrains Mono are embedded in the binary as woff2 files with their OFL licences and served under /static/, so pages load nothing from the network.

fields.acceptance: A web package test renders the layout and each partial with fixture data and compares the HTML with golden files regenerated by -update.
fields.statement: The shared layout (header with daemon pill and live indicator, nav to Overview, Runs and Roadmap) and the partials every page uses (panel with kicker, status pill per run and change set state, dense row with a teal short ID, typed node glyph, step timeline, always-dark terminal block, empty and stale states) render from the design system.
Claude Design's output for the web UI: has the owner run the design prompt, and where does the builder find the design system it produced (token sheet, components, page designs)?
